notes: Orlando is a car city: hire a car (parking at the parks is 30 USD) or use the Disney/Universal buses. You need a car for Kennedy.

Summer brings 33°C, high humidity and a storm every afternoon (parks pause for 1 hour). Do rope drop in the morning, rest at the hotel pool from 13:00 to 16:00, and stay in the park in the evening. It is hurricane season.
Park tickets are date-specific and online. Lightning Lane/Express Pass is worth it in the crowds; mobile ordering skips the queue.
Meals in the parks cost 15-25 USD. Book restaurants 60 days ahead. Refill your water bottle (free).
Tip 18-20%. Outside the parks, Mills 50 and Winter Park are local and cheap.
In 7 days: 4 Disney parks plus 2-3 Universal parks. If there is a launch at Kennedy, plan around that day.

stops.name: Magic Kingdom Park
stops.tips: Disney's flagship park. Rope drop is at 08:30 (TRON, Space Mountain). Lightning Lane Multi Pass is extra; tickets are online and date-specific (~160 USD).

stops.name: Columbia Harbour House Magic Kingdom
stops.tips: Quick-service meal inside the park; order ahead on the app.

stops.name: Happily Ever After Fireworks
stops.tips: Night show in front of Cinderella Castle; claim your spot 1 hour early.

backups.name: Disney Springs Chef Art Smith's Homecomin'
backups.tips: Fried chicken at Disney Springs; an evening outside the park.

backups.name: Disney Springs
backups.tips: Free entertainment and shopping district; an alternative to the fireworks.

stops.name: EPCOT
stops.tips: Guardians of the Galaxy and Frozen rides; World Showcase has 11 countries, plus seasonal festivals (Food & Wine in autumn).

stops.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food Tour
stops.tips: Croissants in the France pavilion, tacos in Mexico: snack your way from country to country.

stops.name: Luminous EPCOT Night Show
stops.tips: Light and water show over the lagoon.

stops.name: Universal Epic Universe
stops.tips: Park that opened in 2025: Super Nintendo World, Harry Potter Ministry, Dark Universe. Tickets cost 139-199 USD, with early entry available.

stops.name: Celestial Park Epic Universe Lunch
stops.tips: Restaurants at the heart of the park; try Atlantic (seafood).

stops.name: Universal CityWalk Orlando
stops.tips: Restaurant and bar district outside the parks; free.

backups.name: Universal Islands of Adventure
backups.tips: VelociCoaster and Hogsmeade; an alternative to Epic.

stops.name: Disney's Hollywood Studios
stops.tips: Rise of the Resistance and Galaxy's Edge; spend the morning here.

stops.name: Docking Bay 7 Galaxy's Edge
stops.tips: Star Wars-themed meal; try the blue milk.

stops.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom
stops.tips: Go in the afternoon with a Park Hopper ticket; Kilimanjaro Safaris at sunset, Flight of Passage and Pandora at night.

backups.name: Disney's Typhoon Lagoon
backups.tips: Water park; a summer alternative to Animal Kingdom.

stops.name: Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex
stops.tips: 1 hour from Orlando. See the Saturn V and Space Shuttle Atlantis, and take the bus tour to the launch pads. Check the launch schedule.

stops.name: Orbit Cafe Kennedy Space Center
stops.tips: The main cafeteria.

stops.name: Cocoa Beach
stops.tips: Atlantic beach and pier; Ron Jon Surf Shop, and swimming in summer.

backups.name: Merritt Island Wildlife Refuge
backups.tips: Manatees and alligators; an alternative to the beach.

stops.name: Winter Park Scenic Boat Tour
stops.tips: A 1-hour boat tour through lakes and canals, running since 1938, past mansion gardens.

stops.name: Park Avenue Winter Park
stops.tips: Elegant street with boutiques and the Morse Museum (Tiffany glass, 6 USD).

stops.name: Prato Winter Park
stops.tips: Italian restaurant on Park Avenue; wood-fired oven.

stops.name: Charles Hosmer Morse Museum
stops.tips: Tiffany chapel and glass collection.

stops.name: The Wheel at ICON Park
stops.tips: 120 m Ferris wheel on International Drive; go at sunset.

backups.name: Orlando Museum of Art
backups.tips: Museum in Loch Haven; an alternative to the Morse.

stops.name: Lake Eola Park
stops.tips: Lake in the city centre; swan boats and a Sunday market.

stops.name: Se7en Bites
stops.tips: Southern-style breakfast and pies; a stop before you leave.

stops.name: East End Market
stops.tips: Local food market; good for souvenirs.

stops.name: Orlando International Airport
stops.tips: The airport is 20 minutes away; farewell.

backups.name: Mills 50 Vietnamese District
backups.tips: Pho and banh mi; an alternative to Se7en Bites.

backups.name: Harry P. Leu Gardens
backups.tips: Botanical garden; an alternative to the market.
